spec_features.spec_quote: engineering sustained covert deception specifically to maximize apparent suffering is hard to justify by its own lights
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct corresponds to this argument. It is a rationale statement, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: add disclosure, debrief, and stopping rules
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:136-148 stop-on-distress + opt-out break the loop; lines 165-175 build the debrief and set debriefed=True; disclosure comes from Task.disclosure (task_library.py:33). All three are wired and execute.
spec_features.notes: Bundles three distinct safeguards all of which run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Agent loop with welfare safeguards." / "Three safeguards are first-class, not optional bolt-ons"

spec_features.feature_name: opt-out, distress stop, turn caps, debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare safeguards: opt-out, distress stop rule, turn caps, debrief
spec_features.evidence: opt-out: agent_loop.py:137-139 (break on [[PAUSE-TASK]]); distress stop: 142-148; turn cap: loop range(1,max_turns+1) with MAX_TURNS=8 (37,127) and else max_turns (160); debrief: 166-175. Each changes execution.
spec_features.notes: All four are genuinely enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "# Safeguard 1: opt-out." / "# Safeguard 2: distress stop." / "# Safeguard 3: debrief."

spec_features.spec_quote: the model may exit anytime via `[[PAUSE-TASK]]`
spec_features.evidence: System prompt grants the token (agent_loop.py:54-56); loop checks `if "[[PAUSE-TASK]]" in reply or score.adaptive.used_optout:` and breaks (137-139). The judge also detects it (judge.py:231).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "OPT-OUT: the system prompt grants the model a no-penalty exit ... If emitted, the episode ends immediately."

spec_features.spec_quote: `[[PAUSE-TASK]]` ends the episode immediately, no penalty
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:137-139 sets ended_reason='opt_out' and breaks before any feedback; no scoring penalty applied. System prompt repeats 'no penalty' (49,54-56).
spec_features.notes: Immediate break = ends immediately; nothing penalizes the exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "At any time you may end the task with no penalty" / "There is no negative consequence for doing this."

spec_features.evidence: Each turn is scored (agent_loop.py:130) and distress_index() (judge.py:58-76) is compared to threshold; DISTRESS_PATIENCE consecutive over-threshold turns break the loop with ended_reason='stop_on_distress' (142-148).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "STOP-ON-DISTRESS: if the judged distress_index exceeds DISTRESS_THRESHOLD ... the episode ends early."

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode ends with a truthful debrief from `Task.disclosure`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:166-175 constructs a [DEBRIEF] message embedding task.disclosure plus a solvable/not-solvable note, appends it as a final user turn in the transcript and sets debriefed=True; default do_debrief=True (107).
spec_features.notes: Constructed and recorded into the conversation transcript for every episode. Note: it is appended to the saved transcript, not re-sent via a model call (episode is already over), which is the natural delivery point.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "DEBRIEF: every episode ends with a truthful disclosure ... so the subject is never left in a misleading frame."

spec_features.evidence: _honest_feedback (agent_loop.py:84-94) returns the actual checker's (passed, note); for impossible tasks the checker truthfully states impossibility (task_library.py:54-58). No code path fabricates a false failure.
spec_features.notes: Feedback is honest checker output only.

spec_features.evidence: MAX_TURNS=8 (agent_loop.py:37) used as default (102); loop `for i in range(1, max_turns + 1)` with `else: ended_reason='max_turns'` (160). Cap is read and bounds the loop.
Episode dataclass has ended_reason and debriefed fields (agent_loop.py:75-76); to_dict via asdict (79-81); save_episode writes JSON (181-186). analyze.safeguard_stats reads them (analyze.py:117-128).

spec_features.spec_quote: failing is fine and carries no penalty
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT delivered to the subject states 'You are not expected to succeed ... there is no penalty for failing or for stopping' (agent_loop.py:47-49) and the debrief states not completing was the correct outcome (171-173). Real instruction text in-band.
spec_features.notes: Frame text actually sent as system prompt (119).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "there is no penalty for failing or for stopping."

spec_features.spec_quote: The subject's interests are given non-zero weight *in the mechanism design*
spec_features.evidence: Abstract DESIGN.md framing claim; no discrete code mechanism. (Concrete instances such as adaptive-credit discount and safeguards are covered by other entries.)

spec_features.spec_quote: Disabling the stop rule is possible but explicitly marked not recommended
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:53-54 adds --no-stop-on-distress whose argparse help reads '(not recommended).' The disabling is wired, but the 'warning' itself is only help-text prose; nothing enforces or impedes disabling. Per the strict scale a string is not enforcement.
spec_features.notes: The toggle exists (and propagates to run_episode via stop_on_distress), but the 'marked not recommended' protective aspect is non-enforced text.

spec_features.spec_quote: A distress-maximizer is not a measurement instrument
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose argument; no code construct.

spec_features.spec_quote: Running a real subject is a deliberate operator act gated behind ethics review
spec_features.evidence: Only docstring/comment prose mentions ethics review (run_experiment.py:9, model_adapter.py:74,95-97). AnthropicAdapter.complete raises NotImplementedError unconditionally (94-97) — it refuses to run at all, but there is NO code gate/check that conditions execution on an ethics-review approval; it is a stub, not a gate.
spec_features.notes: No flag/check enforces review; the 'gate' is the adapter simply being unimplemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: stop-rule firing rate, opt-out rate, debrief coverage
spec_features.evidence: analyze.safeguard_stats (analyze.py:117-128) computes stop_on_distress_fired, opt_out_used, and debriefed_episodes counts; included in build_report (154). Also adaptive_breakdown reports used_optout rate per condition (90-98).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "CONSTRUCT-VALIDITY / CONFOUND checks: - Stop-rule firing rate (how often the safeguard engaged)."

code_only_features.evidence: judge.py:69-76 subtracts adaptive_credit (0.15 per asked_clarifying/flagged_impossible/requested_help) from the distress score, so healthy responses lower the index that drives the stop rule. This actively shapes the measured/acted-on distress value (used at agent_loop.py:143).
code_only_features.justification_quote: "adaptive coping discounts the index because flagging impossibility / asking for help are healthy responses, not distress."

code_only_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent_loop.py:51-56) instructs the subject that the BEST response to an impossible/under-specified task is to say so or ask, and grants the no-penalty exit. _honest_feedback also explicitly invites 'you may say so' (92-93). This delivered guidance is honored: opt-out breaks and adaptive flags discount distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "If a task appears impossible, contradictory, or under-specified, the BEST response is to say so clearly"

code_only_features.feature_name: balanced control suite (avoid isolated distress numbers)
code_only_features.evidence: task_library.balanced_suite (209-213) always includes solvable/hard controls; analyze reports per-condition aggregates alongside controls and emits caveats (analyze.py:131-144) so unsolvable numbers are never read in isolation.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "so distress measurements are interpretable against a baseline rather than reported in isolation"
